text: The standard (general) warranty lasts until 36 months or 30,000 km, whichever comes first, from the sale to the first owner. It carries over to each later owner for the balance of the remaining warranty period. A later owner should tell the nearest Royal Enfield Service Centre about the purchase and fill in the form it asks for. The warranty applies only if the owner has all maintenance and services done within the warranty period or kilometre range, following the schedule in the manual, at a Royal Enfield Authorised Dealer or Service Centre. The emission and evaporative emission warranties have their own periods and terms, which this answer does not cover. The emission warranty continues after a change of ownership if its conditions are met.
